title: Witch of the Azure Flame
description:
"Bow before my ultimate magic!"

Tenacious, clever, and merciless—the chronicle of a calamitous girl's rise to becoming the continent's strongest in this witch's war fantasy! The hit series from Shousetsuka ni Narou finally gets a manga adaptation!

No gods. No convenient cheat skills. Only herself to rely on.

A woman who died alone awakens in another world as an orphan girl named Fiore. Purely to survive, she uses her past-life survival knowledge to carve out a solitary existence deep within an uncharted demon forest. But as it turns out, magic actually exists in this world?! After rescuing a young noble girl from an assassin, Fiore's innate magical talents begin to blossom...
author: Hinako Inoue, Kawaku
